content:
![thane furrows](../../uploads/blog/2008/10/thane-204x300.jpg)

The guy in the photo above is named [Steve Oedekerk](http://www.imdb.com/name/nm0644203/), the director/writer of the movies [Bruce Almighty](http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0315327/), [Ace Ventura](http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0109040/), [Patch Adams](http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0129290/), [Kung Pow](http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0240468/) (in which he also acted), [Nothing to Lose](http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0119807/), among others. Well, the guy is simply a genius, and his first performance in the 1991 independent film [High Strung](http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0102032/) is excellent. The film portrays a typical day in the life of children's book author Thane Furrows, who gets annoyed and complains about everything all the time. The movie is basically a [Stand-up Comedy](http://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stand-up_comedy). This video is from a part where Thane complains about his ex, it's hilarious. Tip for those who like to laugh: **WATCH THIS MOVIE**.

`youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B9wFZyUSEBs`

Unfortunately, this movie doesn't exist on DVD, and I also think it's rare to find it in any video rental store on VHS. I have a digitized copy that I made from my [tape I bought on Ebay](http://shop.ebay.com/?_from=R40&_trksid=m38&_nkw=highstrungvhs).
